# Labels

GitHub creates a label automatically the first time it's applied to an issue. This file is the reference list.

| Label | Meaning |
|-------|---------|
| `P0` | Urgent, today |
| `P1` | This week |
| `P2` | Normal (default) |
| `P3` | Someday |
| `queued` | Delegated, waiting for an agent session |
| `in-progress` | Agent is working |
| `needs-input` | Agent is waiting on the owner's answer |
| `review` | Agent finished; owner to accept or revise |
| `assignee:claude` | Delegated to Claude |
| `type:code` | Code change |
| `type:research` | Research or comparison |
| `type:writing` | Writing or docs |
| `type:action` | Acts in the owner's accounts (email, calendar, Drive…) |
